scope: Consolidated working closure register across current packages; not an authority approval register or a claim that all engineering details have been enumerated.

gates.title: Accepted duty, mass/CG and governing load basis
gates.closure_evidence: Controlled normal/fault/maintenance/transport load cases and fatigue spectrum; actual individual mass/CG allocation and wheel loads, including locomotive. Upper mass calculations are not measured tare or ratings.

gates.title: Coordinated wheel/rail contact and gauge
gates.accountable_disciplines: Rail vehicle + track engineers, wheel manufacturer
gates.closure_evidence: Controlled new/worn wheel and rail profiles, back-to-back/gauge/reference definitions, flange/guard/frog clearances, minimum curve/transition and contact/stability assessment; accepted material/manufacturing basis.

gates.title: Bearing/rotating axle/axlebox package
gates.closure_evidence: Exact bearing designation/arrangement, life/load/deflection, fits/shoulders/radii/seals/setting/retention and controlled source CAD; accepted axle strength/fatigue and wheel-seat assembly/inspection procedure.

gates.title: Delivered D1 interfaces and all applied torque
gates.closure_evidence: Exact assembled drum hub pilot/bolt/mating-face/service envelope; spider/cam/chamber geometry, service/spring force-stroke/torque including reverse/low-pressure/fault behavior; complete hub retention and stationary carrier interfaces.

gates.title: Suspension, guides, brake reaction and body support
gates.closure_evidence: Whole-truck sprung/unsprung mass/CG; compatible guide tilt/travel and brake reaction; spring/damper curves and working envelopes; stops/retention, pivot/sidebearer law, empty/loaded/bump/roll/twist wheel-load/stability; exact physical joints.

gates.title: Complete articulated coupling and load path
gates.closure_evidence: Accepted tension/compression/slack/fault/fatigue and articulation; complete bearing/fit/retainers/pin/clevis/draft gear/secondary restraint/frame attachment/guards and service access; actual assembly drawing and tests.

gates.title: Actual continuous engine and drive installation
gates.closure_evidence: Exact order-code shaft/housing and continuous torque/power/heat maps, derating/torsion; powered axle arrangement, supported reduction and motion, drive limits/reversing/failure control, cooling/fuel/exhaust and service/visibility interfaces.

gates.title: Positive seat/floor isolation and panel joints
gates.closure_evidence: Revised coupled hardpoint/panel/fastener/seal stack under tolerances/loads/thermal movement; accepted panel closeouts/inserts/retention and exact production-material proof/cyclic/thermal/wet evidence. Accessible schedule separately.

gates.title: Physical walls, roof, openings and shell
gates.closure_evidence: Actual sections/materials/joints, roof/HVAC loads, doors/locks/emergency egress/glazing retention/fire-weather/drainage/service details and fatigue; complete source geometry, BOM and recognizable coordinated drawings.

gates.title: Accepted climate, outdoor air and actual HVAC
gates.closure_evidence: Design weather/occupancy/door duty and outdoor airflow; exact unit/ADB hardware/manual revision, net sensible/latent/heating/start/nameplate data, roof clamp stack/service paths and exhaust/condensate separation.

gates.title: Complete stored air and brake control
gates.accountable_disciplines: Rail brake/control engineer + pneumatic application specialists
gates.closure_evidence: Full32coach chamber plus separate locomotive/lines/valves inventory, volumes/timing/leak/duty and compressor/reservoir/protection allocation; actual port/hose/state/failure design, isolated/trapped pressure and separation both portions.

gates.title: Electrical distribution, bonding and reserve
gates.accountable_disciplines: Electrical engineer + authority and brake/HVAC/drive engineers
gates.closure_evidence: Selected actual generator/charger/DC loads including compressor assigned once; one-line, fault/voltage-drop/start recovery, neutral/bonding/protection, moving cables/pinouts/isolation and cold/aged emergency reserve/lighting.

gates.title: Actual survey, terrain, formation and access
gates.closure_evidence: Controlled property/topographic ground-distance/vertical datum survey and benchmarks, boundaries/utilities/soil/drainage/crossings/emergency access; NorthPole location when owner supplies it.0%target is not a measured profile.

gates.title: Matched track component and alignment design
gates.closure_evidence: Resolve rail CAD/paper identity and joint-kit differences; accepted rail condition/profile/steel/joints/ties/fastenings/ballast/subgrade, alignment/transitions/turnouts/crossings/clearances and gauge-restraint/thermal/drainage/proof-section acceptance.

gates.title: Applicable boarding/evacuation and real mechanisms
gates.closure_evidence: Recorded jurisdiction/applicable vehicle/station requirements; actual empty/loaded/bump floor/threshold range, station gap/bridge/lift/ramp, separate occupied-chair/companion circulation and failure evacuation; physical stair/guard/gate stow locks and full-motion mounts.

gates.title: Coordinated actual fabrication drawing and joint release
gates.closure_evidence: Per-part material/heat/toughness, datum, machining/fits/tolerances/finish, exact mating parts/fasteners/locking or weld design/WPS, assembly access and distortion strategy; complete load path, source-consistent views/BOM and practical builder review. Not closed by a model hash.

gates.title: Manufacturing and configuration evidence
gates.closure_evidence: Released revision and accepted supplier certificates, qualified processes/personnel, material traceability, actual dimension/weld/NDT/assembly/retention inspection, nonconformance disposition and controlled as-built configuration; signed hold-point release.

gates.title: Authority and integrated operating/maintenance rules
gates.accountable_disciplines: Owner/operator + responsible authorities, engineers, emergency/insurance roles
gates.closure_evidence: Written jurisdiction/applicability determination and required approvals; accepted route occupancy/dispatch, staffing/training, inspection/defect limits, protected boarding, emergency/rescue/towing/reversing rules, maintenance and actual configured manuals. No presumed FRA or amusement exemption.

gates.title: Controlled acceptance and commissioning evidence
gates.accountable_disciplines: Responsible engineers + independent/authority witnesses as applicable
gates.closure_evidence: Approved safe test configurations/methods/instrumentation, numerical acceptance criteria and witness plan before tests; actual traceable results for structure, wheel loads/twist, articulation, empty/loaded forward/reverse/fault braking/parking/air timing/heat, power/HVAC/egress and route operation; formal disposition and operating release.

closure_rule: Only actual accepted dated evidence with responsible professional/authority disposition may close a gate. Interacting designs require iteration; prerequisite graph is a release-order aid, not a one-pass design algorithm.
